scope: Commercial Intelligence; authorised commercial workspace only; no learner source data
source: lib/commercial-intelligence.ts; six existing CRM record families

confidence.source: makeRecommendation confidence argument for the matched deterministic rule
confidence.calculation: Fixed rule values: recipient collision 98; launch-ready outreach 96; frozen proposal buyer/outreach 94; thesis/qualified buyer verification 91; outreach preparation 90; follow-up 93; overdue/missing next action 99. No probability estimation or model confidence calculation.
confidence.interpretation: Implementation rule confidence, not sales probability, conversion prediction or validated reliability
confidence.presentation: Only in Why this action appears disclosure; existing stored value preserved

priority.source: Current opportunity priority, wave, stage, next-action date and most recent recorded activity
priority.calculation: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW weights 18/10/4; WAVE_1/WAVE_2 weights 16/10. Rule base and capped overdue/activity age give score. URGENT >=94, HIGH >=80, MEDIUM >=60, otherwise LOW. Exact per-rule formulas remain in source.
priority.meaning: Order a review queue. It does not rank learners or predict a commercial outcome.

counts.urgent: Number of deduplicated recommendations whose score maps to URGENT
counts.stale: Number of NEXT_ACTION recommendations (overdue or missing next action)
counts.activeOpportunities: Opportunity count excluding WON, LOST and HOLD

evidence: CRM state is a recorded claim, not independently observed customer intent. Verified contact means status VERIFIED plus a nonempty email in CRM; delivery is not verified. Missing recent activity means no recent CRM entry, not proof that no conversation happened. AI prose is separate interpretation and cannot send or change an opportunity.
privacy: Only commercial record context enters this engine. No learner answers, private reflections, Companion conversations or programme sponsor reports are inputs.
